message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters. The central figure is a man with short black hair and a smirk, wearing a blue long-sleeved shirt and dark pants. He stands behind vertical and horizontal grey metallic bars, which have a large grey rectangular lock plate on the right. He checks a watch on his left wrist and holds a light grey jacket draped over his right arm. A tan wheeled suitcase stands on the dark ground behind him.

The top of the cover features the text "INVESTIGASI: SILAP SULAP SAWIT WILMAR" and "ANEKA RUPA TIM SUKSES JOKOWI" separated by a diagonal slash. Large white text at the bottom reads "DIGDAYA NAZARUDDIN," followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "MASIH DIBIDIK DALAM BEBERAPA PERKARA DUGAAN KORUPSI..." and ending with "DIDUGA MENGATUR ANEKA BISNIS DARI BILIK PENJARA." The bottom-left corner includes the date "19-25 MARET 2018," price "RP 45.000," website "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and a barcode with numbers. The background behind the man is a solid black.
